ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Tuition coverage to check

The advertised package covers Home-rate tuition. It should not be treated as full international-fee funding: confirm your fee status and any overseas-fee difference with the university before accepting.

Basic Information

  • Full Project Title: Mitochondrial DNA Repair
  • Host Institution: University of Birmingham
  • Department: School of Biosciences
  • Supervisor: Prof. Hansong Ma
  • Study Level: PhD
  • Duration: 4 years
  • Start Date: 2027
  • Funding Type: funded at the Home-fee rate (Home UK students)
  • Stipend: UKRI rate (tax-free)
  • Tuition Fees: Covered at Home rate (international students must cover fee difference)
  • Eligibility: Home UK students (international applications welcome but must self-fund fee difference)
  • Application Deadline: 24 October 2026
  • Contact: h.ma.6@bham.ac.uk

Project Description

This project investigates the mechanisms of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) repair. Research will be conducted in Prof. Hansong Ma's laboratory, combining genetics, cell biology, and molecular biology approaches using Drosophila and human cell models to uncover the fundamental principles regulating mtDNA inheritance and stability.

Requirements

  • Strong academic background in molecular biology, genetics, or a related field

How to Apply

Email your CV and a cover letter outlining your research interests, relevant experience, and motivation to Prof. Hansong Ma (h.ma.6@bham.ac.uk).

2026/27 UKRI reference rate: the minimum UKRI doctoral stipend is £21,805 per year, tax-free (London institutions +£2,000), effective 1 October 2026.
